title.value: A modified Thompson sampling-based learning algorithm for unknown linear systems
title.justification: The paper focuses on a modified Thompson sampling-based learning algorithm to control unknown linear systems with quadratic cost, improving upon previous approaches by modifying episode length criteria and assumptions.
title.quote: We propose a variation of this algorithm that enforces a lower bound T min on the episode length.

extractions.description: The paper revisits and proposes a variation on a learning algorithm for controlling unknown linear systems with quadratic cost. This modification aims to achieve a Bayesian regret bound while relaxing some technical assumptions. The proposed method involves adjusting episode length dynamically using a minimum threshold, aiming to preserve regret guarantees under less strict conditions, compared to previous methods.

primary_category.justification: The paper is centered on algorithmic developments in control theory and reinforcement learning, specifically for linear systems, rather than eco-responsible themes.

primary_sub_category.quote: The problem of learning an optimal policy for a system with linear dynamics and quadratic cost with unknown parameters has received considerable attention in the literature.

new_primary_sub_category.value: Dynamic Episode Regulation in Reinforcement Learning
new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper modifies Thompson sampling by dynamically regulating episode length, which is a specific advancement in reinforcement learning, particularly under the framework of control systems.
